integrity: All-order incidence-axiom proof with two independent standard-library Fano computations and exhaustive order-three check; computations corroborate but are not used as proof at unbounded order. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The general theorem addresses the existence and classification of power-dominating sets of size at most two in incidence graphs of finite projective planes; at larger orders it establishes only a lower bound of three. At Fano order two it classifies optimum pairs, their token-jump and token-slide graphs, and shortest paths. No statement about higher-budget relocation or higher-order exact power-domination numbers is made.
title: Antiflag mobility and the two-sensor boundary in projective-plane incidence networks
